newsitem.title: UK: Chesterfield spends 11 mln stg on UK site.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield spends 11 mln stg on UK site.

text.p: Britain's Chesterfield Properties Plc said on Wednesday it had bought a development on the south coast for 11.1 million stg.
It said it was buying the 96,000 square foot pre-let and partially completed site from Spen Hill Properties Ltd.
The company said an initial payment of 8.8 million stg would be followed by the remainder when the site was completed, which should be in September.
The site is adjacent to a Tesco supermarket and tenants will be Homebase, Scottish Power, Pet City, Wickes, Tempo and McDonalds.
Current rents total 584,326 stg per year which is expected to rise to 853,246 stg.

"We are continuing to look for opportunities in this area as part of our medium term objectives to strengthen the portfolio," chief executvie Robert Maxted said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
